display_title: Can You Catch Mermaids While Fishing?
description:
Sea, an entertainment company employee who is always tired from overwork and social life, has fishing as her only hobby.

*"I want to get stranded on a deserted island and spend the rest of my life fishing alone!"*

She thinks as she picks up her fishing rod today... and words become seeds! She panics for a moment, but thinking that her companions will report her, she starts fishing on the deserted island with a complacent mind... The heavy taste of the catch makes her excited, thinking it's a big catch, but what Sea has caught is a person... no, a mermaid?! Suddenly, she ends up uncomfortably cohabitating with a mermaid on a deserted island, but this mermaid seems to have a deep story...?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
